match.userMessage: Write a short title for the following request.

response.content:
The Q4 mobile release is on track: 3 of 5 milestones are done and QA has 4 open blockers.

```openui-lang
root = Stack([notice, metrics, progressCard, plan])
notice = Notice("QA blockers", "4 open blockers must close before launch.", "warning")
metrics = Stats([Stat("Crash-free rate", "99.2%", "+1.1 pts", "good"), Stat("Beta users", "12k"), Stat("Open blockers", 4, "+2", "bad")])
progressCard = Card("Progress", [p1, p2, p3])
p1 = Progress("Milestones", 60, "3 of 5 done")
p2 = Progress("QA test pass", 85)
p3 = Progress("Docs", 12)
plan = Card("Milestones", [steps], "Target: Dec 12")
steps = Steps([Step("Design", "done"), Step("API", "done"), Step("Beta", "done"), Step("QA", "current", "4 open blockers"), Step("Launch", "todo"), Step("Store review", "blocked", "Waiting on Apple")])
```

Incident INC-102 is resolved; payments were the hardest hit at 130 minutes.

```openui-lang
root = Stack([stats, table, chart, notice])
stats = Stats([Stat("Duration", "2h 10m"), Stat("Services hit", 4), Stat("Error rate peak", "18%", "+17 pts", "bad"), Stat("Customers", "1,204")])
table = Table(["Service", "Owner", "Impact", "Status"], [["payments", "@alice", "130 min", Tag("Resolved", "success")], ["search", "@bob", "90 min", Tag("Monitoring", "info")], ["notifications", "@carol", "45 min", Tag("Degraded", "warning")], ["auth", "@dan", "5 min", Tag("Down", "danger")]])
chart = BarChart(["payments", "search", "notifications", "auth"], [130, 90, 45, 5], "Minutes of impact", " min")
notice = Notice("Root cause", "An expired TLS certificate on the internal load balancer.", "danger")
```

Postgres is the better fit; Redis is degraded right now.

```openui-lang
root = Stack([cmp, tags, link])

b = Card("Redis", [Fields([Field("Latency", "38 ms"), Field("Status", Tag("Degraded", "warning")), Field("Owner", "Cache team")])], "Cache")

tags = Tags([Tag("postgres"), Tag("redis", "info"), Tag("elasticsearch", "danger")])
link = Link("Runbook", "https://docs.mattermost.com")
```
